VAR Base =
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'Product'[LT1.5 - Category],
        'Product'[LT1.2 - Brand Group],
        FILTER(ALL('Period'[Year 445]), 'Period'[Year 445] = "2025"),
        FILTER(ALL('Ship From'[Country]), 'Ship From'[Country] = "Colombia"),
        "Unit Cases", [Unit Cases AC]
    )
VAR Ranked =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Base,
        "Rank",
        RANKX(
            FILTER(Base, 'Product'[LT1.5 - Category] = EARLIER('Product'[LT1.5 - Category])),
            [Unit Cases],
            ,
            DESC,
            DENSE
        )
    )

    FILTER(Ranked, [Rank] <= 3)
RETURN

    Result,
    "Category", 'Product'[LT1.5 - Category],
    "Brand Group", 'Product'[LT1.2 - Brand Group],
    "Unit Cases", [Unit Cases],
    "Rank", [Rank]
)
ORDER BY [Category], [Rank]
